show.description: A broke delivery rider, Uday, accidentally crosses paths with Sameera, a powerful CEO. A simple accident spirals into misunderstandings, street fights, unlikely friendships, and a contract marriage request that changes everything. As two worlds collide, Uday must navigate pride, poverty, and opportunity in a city where luck can flip in a heartbeat.
